name: agntux-gmail
description: Gmail integration for AgntUX. Ingests inbox threads into your knowledge store, drafts replies on demand, and saves them to Gmail Drafts for one-click review-and-send.
recommended_ingest_cadence: Every 60 min, 7am–7pm weekdays local — email is bursty during the workday but doesn't need higher resolution than every 60 min
